summary: Smith Ridge, a 15-foot pole platform tower built in 1918 in Clearwater County, was abandoned in the 1930s; no source describes what remains.

facts.status_note: The Forest Fire Lookout Association files it as an abandoned site, not a standing tower. No source we read describes what, if anything, remains today.

events.note: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts both date the pole platform tower to 1918.
Both sources give the abandonment as the 1930s, not a single year.
Firelookout.com says the tower was still there in the 1980s.

evidence.supports: 15-foot pole platform tower, built 1918, abandoned in the 1930s, still there in the 1980s
evidence.quote: This 15' pole platform tower, built in 1918, was abandoned in the 1930's but still there in the 1980's.

evidence.supports: About 12 miles west-northwest of the Canyon Ranger Station
Built 1918 as a pole platform tower
Site tagged Drive-Up and listed as abandoned

evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

evidence.supports: Listed under lookout sites and non-lookout structures

corrections.why: The FFLA Idaho list files Smith Ridge under Lookout Sites / Non-lookout Structures with the status Abandoned, not Gone. Nothing we read says the structure is gone.
Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts both give the abandonment as the 1930s, not a single year.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says the tower was still there in the 1980s, while the FFLA list files the site only as Abandoned. Neither says what stands now, so the record says abandoned and makes no claim about current condition.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts agree on the 1918 build and the 1930s abandonment, and FFLA files the site as abandoned. The 2016 Clearwater National Forest lookout list (fs.usda.gov/media/259185) has no Smith Ridge entry. Its nearby Smith Point (9 miles WNW of Canyon RS, 100-foot L-6 tower, fell in the 1950s, 4550 ft) is a different site and was not used. The FFLOS photo captioned Smith Ridge Lookout 1942 (firetower.org media 2774) is an Oregon lookout in Douglas County and must not be attached to this Idaho record. Height 4.6 m is converted from the 15-foot figure. Visit fact is the Drive-Up tag only; no route or access level is in the sources. No new photos added. Our record's location (46.89819, -115.79393) is the FFLA value. The Idaho record value (46.8984, -115.7942) is a few tens of metres away, and the Idaho page text itself has no coordinates; no conflict is flagged.
